The '''C-88 Fragmentation Missile''' was a fragmentation [[Missile/Legends|missile]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Like [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], it was used against infantry.<ref name="DC" />
